data.body: Scope correction (supersedes the prior comment beginning `Current 166-block allowlist`): the canonical edit set is that ledger minus two already-concise, load-bearing comments in `tests/external/live_jira_dc/_dc_fixtures.py`: the comment before `scrub_bridge_state(tracker)` at pinned-blob lines 253-254, and the comment before `bound = …` at pinned-blob lines 336-337.
